metadata.description: Start here: how to set up and use the DLSS 5 Neural Rendering library, step by step.
Run a video (or one preview frame) through DLSS 5 Neural Rendering with intensity / tone / structure / skin controls and optional 1.5x-3x DLSS Super Resolution.
Run a single image through DLSS 5 Neural Rendering with the same look controls and quality presets as the video node, plus optional 1.5x-3x DLSS Super Resolution. Alpha is preserved.

Loop a clip through the native DLSS 5 worker and adjust tone / structure / skin / style live with a before-after wipe; Bake renders the full clip to the project's outputs. Uses the bundled native worker with the DLLs from a DLSS 5 Visual Enhancer install.

Always-live still preview: landscape widget with the image on the left and look controls on the right. Slider changes hit the resident native worker immediately. Bake writes output_image. Separate from the one-shot Image render node.
